data.sub: Delhi ke kai ilaqon mein AQI 400 ke paar pahunch gaya hai.

chat.say: Bahar chal, mausam kitna romantic hai!
Bhai wo fog nahi, 400 AQI ka smog hai!

data.asar: Bahar nikalte waqt mask lagana mat bhoolna dosto.
data.caption:
Delhi walo, saans sambhal ke lo! 😷

• Delhi-NCR mein pradushan ka kahar fir shuru ho chuka hai.
• DU, Dwarka aur Burari samet kai ilaqon mein AQI 400 ke paar pahunch gaya.
• Subah se hi aasmaan mein zehreeli dhundh chhayi hui hai.

Is mausam ko romantic samajhne ki galti bilkul mat karna!

Apne us dost ko tag karo jo is smog ko winter vibes bol raha hai! 👇
